dedupe_keys.name: cellmapper crowdsourced cellular tower and signal map

description: CellMapper is a crowd-sourced cellular tower and coverage mapping service. Contents: tower locations with per-cell information searchable by provider, network, band, BSIC/PCI/PSC, LAC/TAC and cell identifiers, with filters for first seen and last updated dates, low-accuracy towers, towers with or without frequency and bandwidth data, verified or unverified towers, LTE carrier-aggregation towers and 5G ENDC-capable towers, tower types (macrocell, microcell, picocell, distributed antenna system, cell on wheels, decommissioned), signal trails and provider statistics. Producer: CellMapper and its contributors; users must be logged in to edit data. Coverage: worldwide, with density depending on contributors. Access: an interactive map viewable in the browser, with account login for editing, and a request limit that triggers a verification challenge, so bulk extraction is restricted. Licence and cost: free to view; data reuse terms were not read on the page. Caveats: positions are estimated from crowdsourced measurements, accuracy is flagged per tower, and completeness and currency vary by area. Simulation uses: an open view of tower and band deployments for coverage, capacity and exposure analyses where operator data are unavailable. Related record: OpenCellID (data-opencellid), another crowdsourced tower database.
